headlines.headline: Kings waive six-time All-Star DeMar DeRozan; Harden agrees to return to Cavaliers
headlines.detail: Sacramento waived DeRozan, making him one of the top names still on the open market. James Harden agreed to a three-year, $97 million deal to rejoin Cleveland, and Atlanta added guard Lu Dort in a three-team trade with Oklahoma City and Dallas that also brought in Ryan Nembhard.

headlines.headline: League races to 53-man rosters before Sunday's 6 p.m. ET cutdown deadline
headlines.detail: All 32 teams are trimming from 90 to 53 players. Miami has already waived 12 players, and Cleveland's Dillon Gabriel faces an uncertain roster spot in a crowded quarterback room.

headlines.headline: North Carolina upsets TCU 15-10 in Dublin to open Bill Belichick's second season
headlines.detail: A defensive-driven win at Aviva Stadium in Dublin, Ireland opened the 2026 FBS season. No. 14 USC also routed San Jose State 56-28 at the Coliseum.

headlines.headline: Big 12 lands twelve fifth-year seniors as eligibility rulings reshape the portal
headlines.detail: Court decisions clearing fifth-year and formerly-professional players for eligibility have flipped the transfer portal's late-offseason economics; Texas Tech, Cincinnati, BYU, West Virginia, Oklahoma State, Arizona, and Houston all landed veteran starters.
